mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior 3 months signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 7.5%, it indicates a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 7.5.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 0.25%), higher interest rates reduce corporate borrowing and consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.25.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (the 2017 base) indicates weakening manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 3 months signals improving consumer demand for housing, which supports economic growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST has risen over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 100,000 jobs per month indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000 jobs per month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which supports consumer confidence and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS rises in the prior month.
